class.name: Obfuscation
class.brief_description: First-party identity, mark, copyright lattice, and evidence singleton.
class.description: [Obfuscation] plants verifiable marks in images, WAV PCM, scripts, and packed trees. When [code]obfuscation/pack/scramble_names[/code] is on, export and [method write_obfuscated_tree] also HMAC-rename every packed path (except [code]project.godot[/code]), every user GDScript identifier, and scene-tree names (node names, [NodePath] segments, groups, ExtResource/SubResource ids, autoload keys, and input actions). With [code]obfuscation/scripts/minify[/code] and [code]obfuscation/scripts/comment_lattice[/code] (both on by default), author comments are stripped first, then seeds, copyright shards, and reference strings are stored in HMAC-tagged [code]# ~[/code] / [code]-- ~[/code] pseudo-comments. [method comment_ref] lookups fail if those comments are removed. Engine APIs, keywords, class names, UI text, and helper names such as [code]_obfuscation_cref[/code] stay readable so the game still runs and scanners can still identify marks by content. This is evidence and friction, not a replacement for pack encryption. Private keys stay under [code]user://obfuscation/[/code] and are never packed. Generate and verify claim images with the BlazeSeal app, or use [code]--obfuscation-verify[/code] after scene initialization. Seed assignment is case-insensitive, so renaming [code]Foo.gd[/code] to [code]foo.GD[/code] still matches.

method.name: can_watermark_image
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param image] meets the configured minimum size.

method.name: canonicalize_path
method.description: Returns a case-folded, slash-normalized path used for seed and shard assignment. [code]res://Foo/Bar.GD[/code] and [code]res://foo/bar.gd[/code] canonicalize to the same string.

method.name: clear_identity
method.description: Deletes the local identity. Refused in packed (non-editor) builds.

method.name: collect_copyright_shards
method.description: Collects [code]_CI[/code]/[code]_CR[/code] shard dictionaries from script sources.

method.name: collect_script_identifiers
method.description: Returns user [code]var[/code]/[code]func[/code]/[code]const[/code]/[code]signal[/code]/[code]enum[/code]/[code]class_name[/code] names from [param source]. Keywords, ClassDB types, engine virtuals, and identity markers such as [code]_CK[/code] are omitted.

method.name: comment_ref
method.description: Returns the MAC-valid lattice value for [param slot] from [param source], or an empty [Variant] if the comment is missing, stripped, or bound to a different packed path.

method.name: copyright_hash
method.description: Returns SHA-256 of the base64 copyright notice, or zeros when unset.

method.name: copyright_hash_matches
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param hash] equals [method copyright_hash].

method.name: decode_seal_file
method.description: Loads an image from [param path] and decodes a claim seal.

method.name: decode_seal_image
method.description: Decodes a 256×256 claim image into [ObfuscationClaim].

method.name: derive_seed
method.description: Returns the first 8 bytes of HMAC-SHA256(identity, [method canonicalize_path] of [param path]) as a signed integer.

method.name: derive_seed_bytes
method.description: Returns the 8-byte HMAC seed for the canonicalized [param path].

method.name: embed_spectrogram
method.description: Embeds a compact spectrogram digest of [param image] into float32 PCM.

method.name: export_public_key
method.description: Writes the public half of the current identity to [param path].

method.name: extract_image_watermark
method.description: Extracts a 16-byte image mark, or an empty array if none is present.

method.name: extract_pcm_watermark
method.description: Extracts a 16-byte mark from float32 PCM.

method.name: extract_seeds_from_source
method.description: Finds [code]const _CK[/code] numeric seeds and MAC-decoded lattice [code]k[/code] slots in script source.

method.name: extract_stream_watermark
method.description: Extracts a PCM mark from an [AudioStreamWAV] 16-bit stream.

method.name: generate_identity
method.description: Creates an RSA-2048 identity and HMAC secret under [code]user://obfuscation/[/code].

method.name: generate_seal_image
method.description: Returns a deterministic 256×256 claim PNG image for the current identity.

method.name: get_copyright_base64
method.description: Returns the in-engine base64 encoding of [method get_copyright_canonical].

method.name: get_copyright_canonical
method.description: Returns [code]author|license|text[/code] with empty fields omitted.

method.name: get_owner_id
method.description: Returns the first 16 bytes of SHA-256 of the public key PEM.

method.name: get_project_id
method.description: Returns the identity project id, or the Project Settings fallback.

method.name: get_public_key
method.description: Returns the current public key, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: has_identity
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when an identity key is loaded.

method.name: import_public_key
method.description: Loads a public key from [param path] for verify-only use.

method.name: inject_copyright_source
method.description: Inserts consumed [code]_CI[/code]/[code]_CR[/code] shard constants for [param path].

method.name: inject_into_pack_tree
method.description: Writes [code]claimkey.png[/code] and [code]manifest.bin[/code] under [param output_dir], using [method output_artifact_path] so packed names can be scrambled.

method.name: inject_script_source
method.description: Inserts [code]const _CK[/code] and optional copyright shards into GDScript source, or HMAC-tagged lattice comments when [code]obfuscation/scripts/comment_lattice[/code] is on.

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Returns the [code]obfuscation/enabled[/code] Project Setting.

method.name: load_identity
method.description: Loads the identity from [code]user://obfuscation/[/code].

method.name: output_artifact_path
method.description: Pack path for a logical artifact. When [code]obfuscation/pack/scramble_names[/code] is on, this is [method scramble_output_path]; otherwise [param logical] is returned unchanged.

method.name: parse_script_comments
method.description: Scans [code]# ~[/code] and [code]-- ~[/code] lattice comments in [param source] and returns slot to value for lines whose HMAC matches [param packed_path]. Decoys and copies planted in the wrong file are ignored.

method.name: preview_spectrogram
method.description: Renders a spectrogram preview image from float32 PCM.

method.name: reconstruct_copyright
method.description: Reassembles the notice from shards when the hash matches; otherwise returns empty.

method.name: save_seal_image
method.description: Writes the claim PNG to [param path].

method.name: scan_image
method.description: Scans a single image for a seal and DWT mark.

method.name: scan_path
method.description: Scans a folder, PNG, pack, or similar tree for marks and returns a score.

method.name: scan_script
method.description: Scans GDScript source for seed and copyright lattice constants.

method.name: scan_stream
method.description: Scans an audio stream for a PCM mark.

method.name: scramble_identifier
method.description: One-way HMAC mapping from a user identifier to a valid GDScript name ([code]_[/code] plus 12 hex characters). The original name cannot be recovered. Stable for a given identity.

method.name: scramble_output_path
method.description: One-way HMAC mapping from [param logical] to a [code]res://[/code] path with two random folder names and a random file stem. The original name cannot be recovered. The file extension is kept so scanners can still decode PNG and similar payloads.

method.name: scramble_script_source
method.description: Injects [code]_CK[/code]/[code]_CR[/code] then rewrites user identifiers and [code]res://[/code] strings in [param source]. Reserved names and UI string literals that are not exact identifier matches are kept.

method.name: seed_matches
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param value] equals [method derive_seed] for [param path] (case-insensitive) or for the file name alone.

method.name: split_copyright_shards
method.description: Splits the base64 notice into [code]obfuscation/copyright/shard_count[/code] pieces.

method.name: verify_seal
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the claim image signature verifies.

method.name: watermark_image
method.description: Embeds a Haar DWT + QIM mark. Empty [param payload] uses [method get_owner_id].

method.name: watermark_pcm
method.description: Embeds a spread-spectrum mark into float32 PCM.

method.name: watermark_stream
method.description: Watermarks a 16-bit [AudioStreamWAV] in place and returns it.

method.name: watermark_strength
method.description: Relative image-mark strength used by embed (currently 1.0).

method.name: write_evidence
method.description: Writes JSON, Markdown, or a small PDF evidence file from [param scan].

method.name: write_obfuscated_tree
method.description: Copies [param src_dir] into [param out_dir] with identity marks injected, PNG watermarks applied, user identifiers and scene-tree names HMAC-renamed, and every file path scrambled except [code]project.godot[/code]. Then writes the seal and manifest via [method inject_into_pack_tree]. Used when export templates are unavailable; the editor export plugin applies the same transform into a pack.

constants.constant: Script [code]_CK[/code] seed or MAC-valid lattice [code]k[/code] comment.
